Megan: Quick sync 1 — benchmarks hub launch next Wed. Need final keywords, JSON-LD snippets, redirect CSV, and an internal-linking + CTA plan.

Priya: Ill cluster these into pillar/subtopic groups and draft meta titles. Share the sheet?
Alex: https://docs.google.com/your-sheet (see tab 'benchmarks')
Tom: Schema plan: Article + FAQ on hub landing, DataDownload for the CSV, Event with potentialAction on the webinar page. Small FAQ example below to drop into CMS.
Tom: ```json
{ "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "FAQPage", "mainEntity": [ { "@type": "Question", "name": "How is inference cost calculated?", "acceptedAnswer": { "@type": "Answer", "text": "We compute cost per 1M tokens using measured throughput across GPU families and amortized infra costs." } } ] }
```
Megan: Redirects 1: consolidating ~12 legacy posts. Eng asks: (1) apply 301s, (2) preserve UTM/query strings, (3) add response header 'x-redirect-source' with original path for analytics. I'll file the ticket.
SEOBot: Redirect validator: 12 entries, 0 conflicts. Reminder: update sitemap, add rel=canonical on merged pages, and run a Screaming Frog crawl in staging.
Megan: Publish checklist: meta titles include primary keyword, structured data validated in staging, redirects smoke-tested, internal CTAs to webinar and CSV download, sitemap + robots reviewed.
Priya: I'll hand off meta titles + hero copy by EOD.
Tom: Perf note: compress hero images and lazy-load charts (Lighthouse flagged).
Megan: Timeline: staging Tue 09:00 PT, review 12:30 PT, prod Thu 02:00 PT. Any blockers?
